name: Quill
tagline: A revision pass for your notes: voice punch-up, continuity check or depth read
description: A craft pass for writing in an Obsidian vault. Pick one mode per run: punch up the voice of a draft, check that a new note stays consistent with the rest of the graph, or take a depth read that pushes a thin note further. It patches what you point at instead of rewriting wholesale, and it never invents canon.
author: the_simonjester
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
